plugins.name: promega-engineering-os
plugins.description: Promega process and automation engineering workspace shaped for the Promega Project Planner V3 Visualizer. Scaffolds a Personal Workspace with Projects/ and Meetings/ mounts plus optional add-ons (Change Controls, DS Revisions, Commissioning, Documentation), three-tier knowledge search (workspace → SharePoint → general), Outlook meeting sync with transcript summarization, team-sharing workflow, and an ISA-88 / FactoryTalk Batch reference tuned to FERMB. Built and tested at the Arnold Center (RDC) for fermentation production support; works for any Promega engineering team on the Logix 5000/500 + FactoryTalk Batch / PhaseManager stack.
